name: v4.0.531
body:
## What's Changed

- `remotion`: Adapt HTML-in-canvas to Chrome 157 implementation by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11829
- `remotion`: Fix connected compositions for `Interactive.withSchema()` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11814
- `remotion`: Hide composition-root `Interactive.withSchema()` sequence from timeline by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11836
- `remotion`: Remove `loop` from `Interactive.baseSchema` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11800
- `@remotion/studio`: Split captions with Enter by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11805
- `@remotion/studio`: Link update release titles to GitHub releases by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11830
- `@remotion/studio`: Remove uneven dimension warnings from composition dialogs by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11810
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix multi-selection timeline resize flicker by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11806
- `@remotion/studio`: Fix vertical timeline jump while scrubbing by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11838
- `@remotion/timeline-utils`: Display timeline waveforms on a decibel scale by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11804
- `@remotion/transitions`: Show `TransitionSeries.Overlay` in JSX order in Studio by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11841
- `@remotion/studio-server`: Reject file source paths outside the project by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11751
- `@remotion/cli`: Fall back to Webpack in WebContainers by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11799
- `@remotion/renderer`: Compensate libfdk_aac priming when muxing ADTS into MP4/MOV by @nicolascoutureau in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11705
- `@remotion/renderer`: Require `videoBitrate` with `encodingBufferSize` for VP8, VP9 and AV1 by @developerjillur in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11818
- `create-video`: Default Tailwind prompt to No and fix installation opt-out by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11812
- `create-video`: Suppress npm install warnings by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11807
- `@remotion/promo-pages`: Add Browser Studio links to templates by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11803

## Elements

- Add Speed Lines storytelling element by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11843
- Make caption Elements flexible in size by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11802
- Cap library card widths and limit rows to three columns by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11833
- Fix navbar flash on first Studio library load by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11828

## Templates

- Hello World template: Make title and logo editable in Studio by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11848
- Electron template: Bump electron from 40.8.5 to 40.10.2 by @app/dependabot in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11822

## Skills

- Open Studio preview before building videos by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11837
- Premount timed components in Remotion markup by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11840

## Docs

- [Make Browse Elements in Studio discoverable](https://remotion.dev/docs/studio/browse-elements) by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11797
- Clarify ElevenLabs transcript input formats by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11821

## Internal and Experimental

- `@remotion/canvas`: Add `queueSequenceNodePathRemappings()` to apply codemod remappings with the next Fast Refresh by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11778
- `@remotion/agent-plugin`: Remove portable manifest from Codex releases by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11808
- remotion.dev/brand: Make the Whats New video editable in Studio by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11811
- Internal testbed: Add WhatsNew video composition by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11825
- Internal testbed: Make Portfolio text layers editable by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11831
- Internal: Add `--old` option to `./new` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11827
- Skills: Add timed PR workflow script by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11834

## New Contributors

- @DeryFerd made their first contribution in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/11751

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/compare/v4.0.530...v4.0.531
